$ evnx convert --to heroku
#!/bin/bash
# Heroku Config Vars
# Generated by evnx
#
# Usage:
#   bash heroku-config.sh --app YOUR_APP_NAME
#
# Or set variables individually:
#   heroku config:set KEY=VALUE --app YOUR_APP_NAME

set -e

echo "Setting Heroku config vars..."

heroku config:set APP_NAME="ClientShop" --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME} || echo "Failed to set APP_NAME"
heroku config:set APP_ENV="production" --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME} || echo "Failed to set APP_ENV"
heroku config:set APP_KEY="" --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME} || echo "Failed to set APP_KEY"
heroku config:set APP_DEBUG="true" --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME} || echo "Failed to set APP_DEBUG"
heroku config:set DB_PASSWORD="changeme" --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME} || echo "Failed to set DB_PASSWORD"
heroku config:set MAIL_PASSWORD="hunter2" --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME} || echo "Failed to set MAIL_PASSWORD"
heroku config:set STRIPE_SECRET="sk_live_51H8xQ2KZvNbGtRsPmWcYdLfE9AjXoTuV" --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME} || echo "Failed to set STRIPE_SECRET"

echo "✓ Config vars set successfully"

# Verify settings:
# heroku config --app ${HEROKU_APP:-YOUR_APP_NAME}

  Docs: https://www.evnx.dev/guides/commands/convert
exit=0
